Tutorials and examples for working with Boolean networks.

Contribute via: <https://github.com/BooleanNet/booleannet.com/tree/main>


```
{{< include data/fragility-rules.txt >}}
```

The rules would form a Boolean network of the following form:

```{dot}
digraph {
  rankdir=LR
  outputorder=edgesfirst
  node [style=filled fillcolor=white fontsize=12 width=0.42 height=0.3 margin="0.04,0.02"]
  edge [penwidth=1.6]
  edge [color="#2563eb"]
  D -> A
  B -> C
  B -> B
  C -> C
 layout=circo
  edge [color="#dc2626" arrowhead=tee]
  A -> B
  A -> C
  B -> D
  C -> A
  D -> B
  
  C -> D
}
```
